name: Protopasta Brass HTPLA
filament_notes:
Brass-filled metal-composite HTPLA. Proto-Pasta data: 200C@24 mm3/s, 55C plate; TDS 195C nozzle, 60C bed, density ~2.3 g/cm3 (~90-100 m per 500 g).
Avoid printing below 3 mm3/s. Hardened nozzle recommended. Brittle in spool form. Polish by sanding/burnishing for real-metal luster; anneal like HTPLA for heat resistance.
